_comment: Why: kernel 0.2.0 (desktop 2.0.16) migrated the settings document out of
~/.dsh/settings.yaml and into the LIVE CONFIG LAYER profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
(the `llm-pi-ai` row). The old file was renamed to settings.yaml.imported. That
file is kernel-generated (reconciled on every boot), so a unified diff against a
pristine baseline can never forward-apply — the old patch was a recovery fiction.
This file replaces it with assertions that are checkable at any time: each anchor
must be present in the live file. Recovery is re-adding the rows, not replaying a diff.

anchors.why: the whole custom-provider block hangs off this row
local DGX Spark GLM-5.3 Flash EXL3 (video-capable)
custom model entry with contextWindow + input + reasoningEfforts

P20 video modality survived the 0.2.0 settings migration; requires the dsh-llm-pi-ai schema patch (patches/post-install/p20-video-modality.mjs). If this disappears, re-apply that patch and re-import settings.yaml.imported.
the AgentOS governance plugin is enabled and points at the client-activation receipt it observes through; losing either line silently unhooks DSH from the governance loop
the receipt path is the governance plugin's only link to the AgentOS broker state
the phone connects through this block; the port 41180 was measured, not defaulted (45120-48120 is partly reserved on this host)
the measured port, with listenHost resolved at render time from DSH_LISTEN_HOST
the chrome-faithful compatibility block forwards AGENTOS_CHROME_CONFIG into the MCP child env
LCO was removed by user decision on 2026-09-30. This asserts the row stays GONE: a replay that re-added it would silently reintroduce an adapter the user retired.
